prompt: # BUILD PROMPT — "ClearInvoice" SaaS Landing Page (Dark Video Hero, Gradient CTA) **Your Role:** You are a Senior Frontend Engineer and Expert UI Designer. Build the complete, production-quality landing page described below in a single attempt. Every rule in this document is mandatory; do not improvise around it. **Objective:** A dark, conversion-focused 2024–2026 SaaS landing page for **ClearInvoice**, an invoicing product for freelancers and agencies. Signature elements: full-opacity HLS background video hero (no overlay), 5px multicolor gradient top bar, orange-gradient primary CTA with glow + inner stroke + sliding arrow, overlapping-avatar social proof, staggered entrance animations, Switzer headings / Geist body. **Sections (in this order):** Gradient top bar → Sticky navigation → Hero → Features (3 cards) → How It Works (3 steps) → Testimonials → Pricing (3 tiers) → FAQ → Final CTA → Footer with secondary links. **Copy Direction:** Write ALL user-facing copy in **English** (never Portuguese or any other language). Realistic, specific invoicing/SaaS copy — no lorem ipsum. Value props to draw from: get paid faster, automated payment reminders, AI invoice drafting, real-time payment tracking. Tone: confident, plain, benefit-led. --- ## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE ### 1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS * **No Inline CSS:** The `style="..."` attribute is forbidden anywhere in the HTML. Zero inline styles. * **Class/ID Selectors Only:** All design properties, layout rules, and states are targeted via class or ID selectors in `style.css`. * **Minimal HTML Modifications:** Markup stays semantic and styling-agnostic; restyling the site must require editing `style.css` only. * **Script Tags:** The only permitted `` entry point. No inline script logic. ### 1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens All visual tokens live in `:root` inside `style.css`. Use exactly this palette: ```css :root { /* Color */ --primary: #FF3300; --secondary: #EA580C; /* orange glow */ --gradient-primary: linear-gradient(135deg, #FF3300 0%, #EE7926 100%); --gradient-topbar: linear-gradient(90deg, #ccccff 0%, #e7d04c 50%, #31fb78 100%); --bg-primary: #000000; --bg-secondary: #0a0a0a; /* card surface */ --surface-light: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); /* secondary CTA surface */ --text-primary: #FFFFFF; /* pairs with --bg-primary / --bg-secondary */ --text-secondary: rgba(255,255,255,0.65); --text-on-light: #000000; /* pairs with --surface-light */ --text-success: #31FB78; --text-error: #FF6B6B; --border-default: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); /* inner stroke */ --border-subtle: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); --border-dark: rgba(0,0,0,0.05); /* borders on light surfaces only */ --border-error: #EF4444; --border-success: #31FB78; /* Radius & Shadow */ --radius-sm: 8px; --radius-md: 12px; --radius-lg: 20px; --shadow-sm: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.45); --shadow-md: 0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.55); --glow-primary: 0 0 48px rgba(234,88,12,0.35); /* Spacing & Motion */ --spacing-gap: 1.5rem; --transition-fast: 200ms; --transition-normal: 300ms; --ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); /* Elevation */ --z-dropdown: 100; --z-modal: 1000; --z-toast: 1100; --z-topbar: 1200; /* Type */ --font-heading: 'Switzer', 'Inter', sans-serif; --font-base: 'Geist', 'Inter', sans-serif; } ``` * **Contrast Pairing:** Every dark background token (`--bg-primary`, `--bg-secondary`) pairs only with light text tokens; every light surface (`--surface-light`) pairs only with dark text (`--text-on-light`). Never place white text on `--surface-light` or black text on `--bg-primary`. * **Light surfaces:** Never use pure `#ffffff` as a page background; if a near-white surface is ever needed, use `#fefefe`. * Every color, radius, shadow, and transition used in component rules must reference these variables — no hard-coded hex values in component CSS. ### 1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode * **Dark is the default and only theme:** The `:root` block above IS the dark palette; the page renders dark on first paint with no flash of light content. * **Exception (per style spec):** Light mode is explicitly not recommended for this theme — ship dark-only: no light token set, no `prefers-color-scheme: light` overrides, no theme toggle, and no `localStorage` theme persistence are required. Dark tokens at `:root` remain mandatory, and every color must stay behind a CSS variable so the palette remains swappable without touching markup. ### 1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment * Build every layout structure with Flexbox (`display: flex` / Tailwind flex utilities). * **Default Alignment Rule:** Every flex container defaults to `align-items: center` (`items-center`) unless an exception is explicitly commented in the CSS (the only permitted exceptions: equal-height card grids using `stretch`). * **Mobile-Friendly First:** All rows convert to columns below the Tailwind `md` breakpoint; typography uses fluid `clamp()` sizing; there is zero horizontal scrolling at any viewport width from 320px upward. ### 1.5 Framework Default & Tailwind CSS Integration * Use Tailwind CSS via the Play CDN for layout, spacing, and alignment utilities only. Do **not** add an inline `tailwind.config` script — all custom design values belong in `style.css`. * All brand styling (gradients, glows, component classes) lives in `style.css`, either as plain CSS or inside `@layer components` with `@apply`, and binds to the `:root` variables. * Required reusable component classes: `.btn`, `.btn--primary`, `.btn--secondary`, `.btn--ghost`, `.btn--danger`, `.card`, `.input-group`, `.badge`, `.section`, `.container`. ### 1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory) * **Headings:** Switzer (weights 500–700) bound to `--font-heading`. * **Body:** Geist loaded from Google Fonts (`fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Geist:wght@400;500;600&display=swap`) and bound to `--font-base`. * **Exception (Switzer):** Switzer is not distributed on Google Fonts — load it from the Fontshare CDN (`https://api.fontshare.com/v2/css?f[]=switzer@400,500,600,700&display=swap`). All other fonts and all icons remain Google-hosted. * **Icons:** Google Material Symbols only (Rounded variable font via Google Fonts), used as `icon_name` with `font-variation-settings` for filled variants. * **Forbidden:** raw inline SVGs, local icon files, emoji used as icons. Photographs (avatars, testimonial portraits, video poster) are images, not icons, and may use documented placeholder URLs. --- ## 2. COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS ### 2.1 Button Component (`.btn` + variants) * **Base `.btn`:** `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;` minimum touch target 44×44px, `font-family: var(--font-base)`, `font-weight: 600`, `border-radius: var(--radius-md)`, `cursor: pointer`, transitions bound to `var(--transition-fast) var(--ease-standard)`. * **Primary CTA (`.btn--primary`) — the signature element:** * Background `var(--gradient-primary)`; text `var(--text-primary)`. * **Inner stroke:** `border: 1.5px solid var(--border-default)`. * **Glow:** a `::before` pseudo-element behind the button carrying the same gradient with `filter: blur(24px); opacity: 0.2; z-index: -1; border-radius: inherit;`. * **Hover:** `transform: scale(1.05)`; glow animates to `opacity: 0.6`; **sliding arrow:** an `arrow_forward` Material Symbol inside the button starts at `opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-8px)` and slides to `opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0)` on hover/focus. Reserve the arrow's gap so the animation never changes button dimensions. * **Focus-visible:** distinct ring (`outline: 2px solid var(--text-primary); outline-offset: 3px`) visible against both the black page and the orange button. * **Active/Pressed:** `transform: scale(0.97)`. * **Loading (`.is-loading`):** `pointer-events: none` (prevents double-clicks); label swaps to a rotating `progress_activity` Material Symbol driven by a CSS keyframe; button dimensions never change. * **Disabled:** `opacity: 0.5; filter: grayscale(1); cursor: not-allowed;` no hover transform. * **Success/Error (`.is-success` / `.is-error`):** temporary feedback recoloring to `--border-success`/`--text-success` or `--border-error`/`--text-error`, always paired with an icon and text — never color alone. * **Secondary CTA (`.btn--secondary`):** `background: var(--surface-light); color: var(--text-on-light); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border: 1.5px solid var(--border-dark);` hover = subtle brightness lift + `--shadow-sm`; inherits all base states (focus, active, loading, disabled). * **Ghost (`.btn--ghost`):** transparent background, `--border-default` border, white text — used in pricing and footer. * **Danger (`.btn--danger`):** distinct red treatment built from `--text-error`/`--border-error`; must be unmistakably different from the orange primary at all times. ### 2.2 Card Component (`.card`) Used by Features, Testimonials, Pricing, and FAQ items. * **Default:** Flexbox column layout, `background: var(--bg-secondary); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); padding: 1.5rem;`. * **Hover (interactive cards only):** `transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
